dq_rules.rule_name: Contact Name Not Null or Empty

ansi.substituted_query: WITH null_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_nulls FROM sample_db.public.customers WHERE (contact_name IS NULL OR contact_name = '') AND 1=1), overall_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM sample_db.public.customers WHERE 1=1) SELECT total_rows AS rows_total, (total_rows - total_nulls) AS rows_passed, total_nulls AS rows_failed, CASE WHEN try_divide((total_rows - total_nulls) * 100.0, total_rows) >= 0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status FROM null_count, overall_count;
ansi.failure_predicate: (1=1) AND (contact_name IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(contact_name AS STRING)) = '')
